target_audience: Football players, athletes, fans in Mali and internationally

headings.styles: Confident, clean geometric sans. Use uppercase with tight tracking (tracking-tight) for promotional banners and main titles to evoke a professional athletic feel.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight uppercase font-bold
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight uppercase font-bold

accent.description: Signal Red - Bold, energetic, commercial, used for CTAs, sale badges, active states.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-4 to p-8 for containers, gap-6 to gap-8 for grids.
layouts.product_grid: Regular, consistent product grid. grid-cols-2 (mobile) to grid-cols-4 (desktop).
layouts.mobile_first: Ensure filters are in a slide-out drawer on mobile, and standard sidebar on desktop. Sticky bottom CTA for add to cart on mobile product pages.
layouts.header: Solid white or glassmorphism (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with 1px border-b border-gray-200. Must include Language (FR/EN) and Currency (EUR/USD/XOF) switchers.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_radius: Sharp edges or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm or max rounded-md) to maintain a serious, professional, technical sportswear feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for dropdowns/modals. Avoid large soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react. Simple, homogeneous, outlined icons with consistent stroke widths.
visual_enhancers.badges: Use rectangular badges for 'NEW' (black/white) and 'SALE' (Accent Red/White) placed at the top-left of product images.

motion.philosophy: Light animations only when they improve experience. Nothing overloaded.
motion.interactions: Hover states on product cards: slightly fade in second image. Button hover: slight color darkening and transform scale (scale-[1.02]).
motion.transitions: Use transition-colors duration-200 for links/buttons. Avoid universal 'transition-all'.

product_card.structure: Image (aspect-[4/5] object-cover bg-gray-100), brand name (small, gray), product name (base, dark), price (current + old if sale), badges (absolute top-left), wishlist icon (absolute top-right).
product_card.hover: Show alternative image on hover if available. Show quick 'Add to Cart' button at bottom of image.

components_instructions.filters: Use Shadcn Accordion or Checkboxes for categories, brands, sizes, colors.
components_instructions.checkout: Multi-step (Contact, Shipping, Payment, Review). Use Shadcn forms and inputs.
components_instructions.admin_dashboard: Use tight grids, solid borders, clear KPI cards, and Shadcn data tables.

hero_banners.description: Football player in red jersey (for Hero banner)

jerseys.description: Blue and white jersey holding ball

training_wear.description: Man holding soccer ball in training wear

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='product-price').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Grey text on white must be at least text-gray-500, prefer text-gray-600 or darker for readability.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dropdowns, Selects, Accordions, Dialogs).
Use Lucide icons strictly for uniformity.
Do not use generic 'transition: all', use specific transition properties.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are attached to all actionable components.
Header must not be fully transparent if overlapping images; use a semi-transparent or solid white background to ensure navigation links remain legible.
Ensure currency switcher supports EUR, USD, XOF and language switcher supports FR, EN.
Mobile layout must be prioritized: use hamburger menus and slide-out bottom sheets or drawers for filters on mobile.
